e95135e50ec51b5b0bbd.text: Now scale it up. Every wall in Midtown has had the same treatment.

e9c7bb6159b7af752e5b.text: Concrete soaks up heat all day and gives it back after dark. A city never cools.

ea0d87ed6c54fdf4253d.text: Floor fifteen is worst. Fifty-six outside, forty-seven inside, thirteen hundred hours.

eb444bd244034da86938.text: Nobody has mapped what heat actually does to a building, wall by wall and hour by hour.

ec0faf2e2a8bbff906e9.text: So it recommends glass. Low solar-gain units, floors five to thirty-five, that face only.

ed59d57039e78d56df66.text: The north-west face catches the late sun. Floor fifteen hits fifty-six.

ee9e83c38e7b7b0d0151.text: On the flat map it's one shade of orange. It's nowhere near that even.

efd51e9982409dde9f47.text: So where's that from? The forty-five-storey tower opposite, radiating heat back at it.

f0256c866c6b396c3e34.text: So it prescribes the glass instead.

f040282b6f2569bd77bc.text: It told him no. The heat is coming through his glass, not his masonry.

f2600f11ad59fb54c676.text: So where's that from? The wall across an eighteen-metre street, radiating heat straight back at it.

f33418f8724ea770412b.text: On the flat map it's one shade of orange. It isn't one temperature.

f4fadb208e0c73486d2a.text: So the model breaks it up. Ten bands, every face apart. Forty-four degrees at the bottom, fifty-seven just above it.

f68a40c702d837258f3e.text: Every building gets a brief. This one opens with three findings.

fa21ea883ebf4bc04350.text: Take this one as an example. Five sixty Third Avenue, thirty-five floors.

fb606fb1b8a887bb6f9c.text: Now round to the north-east. Same floor, no sun, still forty-two.

fb9b327ef118de070c44.text: Then floor by floor. Surface temperature, the cost of holding twenty-four inside.

fbddbb23d26264ea32f8.text: Now round to the north-east. Same floor, no sun, and still hot.

fdccdf9cc402eb628078.text: Now scale it up. Every wall in Midtown has had the same treatment.

fe003de34363ba293711.text: Eight ways to read it. Surface temperature, sun and shade, hours above thirty-five, where to act first.

fe795132a7bebeaa2dd2.text: Change something and it solves again. Cool roofs, trees, a coating.

ff71ed054880f22b9ae6.text: Run the year and the ranking shifts. Twelve of that day's worst fifty are still worst.

ffe8928616617c2eccff.text: And what that bought. One point nine million hours of heat nobody sits through.
